Name: SemperisLightning
Author: Semperis
Description: This solution includes two data connectors for Semperis Lightning: a Function App connector that pulls data and uploads it into the selected Log Analytics workspace via the Azure Log Ingestion API, and a Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) connector that deploys REST API pollers to ingest data directly, with support for onboarding multiple Semperis Lightning environments independently.
